name: preprocess_exact
what: assignment preprocessing equals the same formula in signed int64 (shape 88x80x1, int8)

name: preprocess_raw_unchanged
what: the raw frame is not modified by preprocessing

name: mspacman_color_unique
what: pixels with RGB sum 448 that are not Ms. Pac-Man's (210,164,74)

name: mspacman_visible
what: share of frames in which Ms. Pac-Man is visible

name: mspacman_compact
what: share of visible frames whose (210,164,74) pixels fit in 12x12 (one sprite)

name: frame_stack_reset
what: first state of episode 2 = 4 copies of its own reset frame, none from episode 1

name: life_loss_not_terminal
what: lives fall 3->0 in one episode; only the game-over transition has d=1

name: reward_clip_vs_score
what: stored reward = sign(raw reward); score = sum of raw rewards
observed: raw rewards [0.0, 10.0], stored [0.0, 1.0], score 220.0 vs raw sum 220.0

name: buffer_partial
what: capacity 5 holding 3: 1000 samples come only from filled slots

name: buffer_wrap
what: capacity 5 after 8 adds holds the 5 newest

name: epsilon_bounds[CartPole-v1]
what: epsilon at steps 0, decay/2, decay, 10*decay

name: epsilon_bounds[ALE/MsPacman-v5]
what: epsilon at steps 0, decay/2, decay, 10*decay

name: target_sync
what: target constant within each 100-step window, = online right after a sync, != online otherwise

name: truncation_bootstrap
what: episode cut by a 20-step limit with the pole still up: last stored d

name: termination_terminal
what: pole falls (last state outside the limits): only the last transition has d=1

name: chain_q_star
what: learn() on all 8 transitions converges to the closed-form Q* (gamma 0.9)

name: chain_greedy
what: greedy action in every state

name: chain_terminal
what: Q(3, right): the goal transition is terminal, so no bootstrapped term

name: td_targets_hand
what: targets for a non-terminal and a terminal transition

name: trace_mspacman_deterministic
what: two MsPacman traces without sticky actions, same seed

name: divergence_guard
what: lr = 1e30 must stop training with an error naming episode and step; saved files load
expected: RuntimeError at the first learning episode, model.pt and train.csv readable
observed: 'training diverged at episode 35, global step 1000: non-finite Q-value at step 0 of the episode'; train.csv episodes 1..34, model.pt from episode 20

name: wall_clock_stop
what: a 2-second limit ends training after the first episode that finishes past 2 s
expected: stop=time, episodes_done = rows, every row but the last at <= 2.0 s, all outputs written
observed: stop=time, episodes_done=133, rows=133, last two times [2.0, 2.0], outputs True

name: interrupted_run
what: SIGKILL during training, then --eval-only
expected: episodes 1..k once each, eval-only exit 0, all outputs, metrics episodes = k
observed: episodes 1..37 in order: True, exit 0, outputs True, metrics episodes 37

name: determinism_cpu
what: two 40-episode CartPole runs with the same seed (learning from step 200)
observed: logs identical True, weights identical True, learning happened True

name: seed_disjoint
what: reset-seed ranges of training (seeds 0-2), evaluation, selection and validation

name: moving_average_alignment
what: trailing 100-episode mean of 1..150, and of a 30-episode run

name: histogram_single_value
what: 500 equal evaluation scores
